name: Helmo Rénovation
description: Full redesign (SEO, UI and UX) of an 80-page WordPress site for an all-trades renovation company, delivered in 2 months.
context: Helmo Rénovation is a French all-trades renovation company (interior work, energy retrofits, projects for professionals) that delivers turnkey projects with its own in-house teams.

I rebuilt the site from the ground up in 2 months: architecture, SEO for all 80 pages, markup, performance and content. The site runs on WordPress with the Elementor page builder and is hosted on Hostinger.

work.title: Site architecture
work.text: A very broad offering, reorganized into clear topic silos so both Google and visitors instantly understand the structure.
points: Three main silos: interior renovation, energy renovation and services for professionals.
Sub-pages by property type, by room and by trade (insulation, heating, ventilation, electrical, plumbing…).
Internal linking between pages of the same silo and breadcrumbs across the whole site.

work.title: SEO for all 80 pages
work.text: Each page targets a specific search intent and was optimized individually.
points: Unique title tags and meta descriptions written to earn the click.
A single H1 per page and a consistent H2/H3 hierarchy.
Segmented XML sitemap (pages, posts, categories) to make crawling easier.

work.title: Images and alt text
work.text: Every image was renamed and described so search engines understand it and screen readers can announce it.
points: Descriptive alt attributes, written from the actual image content and the page's target keyword.
WebP conversion and lazy loading for off-screen visuals.

work.title: Markup and structured data
work.text: Complete schema.org markup so Google and AI engines clearly identify the company, its pages and its structure.
points: Organization and LocalBusiness for the company's identity.
WebSite and WebPage on every page.
BreadcrumbList to expose the site tree in search results.

work.title: Page speed optimization
work.text: A visually rich Elementor site, slimmed down to stay fast on mobile.
points: LiteSpeed server cache, provided natively by Hostinger.
Images compressed to WebP and lazy-loaded.
Cleanup of unused Elementor elements and scripts.

work.title: Automated article generation
work.text: An automated blog production process that keeps the site supplied with targeted content on a regular schedule, with no manual workload.

work.title: FAQ rewrite for GEO
work.text: The FAQs were rewritten to be picked up by generative engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity…).
points: Questions phrased naturally, the way a customer would ask an AI.
A direct answer in the very first sentence, then the details.
Short, factual wording that is easy to quote.

design.summary: On the interface side: a night blue that builds trust, an orange reserved for calls to action, and a single typeface, Poppins, for fast reading on mobile.
